visual_action: A static, unflattering close-up photo of Donald Trump is displayed. A list of policy points and phrases is overlaid in black text on the bottom half of the image.

cast.evidence: An unflattering photo of Donald Trump serves as the entire visual background for the video.

cast.evidence: The text 'Project 2025' appears in a list of policies overlaid on the image.

central_claim: A Donald Trump presidency would implement a series of negative policies, including abortion bans and cuts to Medicare and Social Security, as outlined in Project 2025.
intended_effect: To create fear and opposition towards Donald Trump by associating him with unpopular or harmful policies.
